{{Short description|Indian mathematician}}
'''Anish Ghosh''' is an Indian mathematician specializing in [[ergodic theory]], [[Lie groups]] and [[number theory]]. He is a Professor in the School of Mathematics of the [[Tata Institute of Fundamental Research]] (TIFR), [[Mumbai]], and is currently Dean of the School. He was awarded the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]] in Mathematical Sciences in the year 2021.<ref>{{cite web |title=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize (SSB) for Science and Technology 2021 List of recipients |url=https://ssbprize.gov.in/WriteReadData/LatestUpdates/202109260133259214500SSBPrize2021Website.pdf |website=SSB Prize in Science and technology |publisher=CSIR Human Resource Development Group, New Delhi |access-date=28 September 2021}}</ref> Anish Ghosh is also a part of the [https://randomgeometry.in/ INFOSYS-Chandrasekharan Virtual Centre for Random Geometry] which is a group of scientists at TIFR Mumbai and ICTS Bengaluru working on topics related to random geometry.<ref>{{cite web |title=Random Geometry Centre|url=https://sites.google.com/view/tifrgeomdyn/home |website=Infosys-Chandrasekharan Random Geometry Centre |publisher=TIFR |access-date=30 September 2021}}</ref>

Anish Ghosh was born on 25 December 1979.<ref>{{cite web |title=Mathematician Anish Ghosh |url=https://nikhilbharat.com/mathematician-anish-ghosh-in-hindi-jivani/ |website=Online Hindi world |date=29 November 2021}}</ref> He secured a BSc degree from St. Xavier’s College, Mumbai in 2001 and received his PhD degree from [[Brandeis University]] in Waltham, Massachusetts in 2006. His research supervisor was Dmitry Yanovich Kleinbock.<ref>{{cite web |title=Anish Ghosh |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=108930 |website=Mathematics Genealogy Project |publisher=Department of Mathematics North Dakota State University |access-date=28 September 2021}}</ref>  After spending a short period as a post-doctoral fellow at the University of Texas at Austin, he joined University of East Anglia, UK as a Lecturer and after a few years he moved to TIFR as a faculty member,

==Recognitions==
Besides the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology, Anish Ghosh has been the recipient of several recognitions, including the following:

* [[National Academy of Sciences, India|NASI]]-[[Scopus]] Young Scientist Award in 2017<ref>{{cite web |title=NASI-SCOPUS Young Scientists Award 2018 |url=https://www.elsevier.com/__data/assets/pdf_file/0005/711977/2018-SYSA-Winner-brochure.pdf |publisher=Elsevier |access-date=30 September 2021}}</ref>
* DST Swarnajayanti Fellowship in 2017
* Fellow of the Indian Academy of Sciences in 2018<ref>{{cite web |title=Fellows and Honorary Fellow |url=https://www.ias.ac.in/Announcements/New_fellows/ |publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences |access-date=30 September 2021}}</ref>
* B M Birla Science Prize in 2017<ref>{{cite web |title=B M Birla Science Prizes |url=https://www.birlasciencecentre.org/awards/previous-receipients-of-the-bm-birla-science-prizes/ |publisher=B M Birla Science Centre |access-date=30 September 2021}}</ref>
* [[Asian Scientist 100]], ''[[Asian Scientist]]'', 2022
* Fellow of the Indian National Science Academy, 2025 <ref>https://insaindia.res.in/recent-elected-fellows/</ref>
* J. C. Bose grant of the ANRF
